cases.title: Runtime observation
cases.observed: Original runtime_info returned bounded invalid_input directing a v8 process to runtime_info_v2 (documented contract). runtime_info_v2 returned bridge 1.0.0, stdio, operator-supplied design registry v8 (2 entries), operator-supplied PDK registry v2 (2 entries), analysis journal operator_supplied, sweep journal package_relative_default; health/execution/environment assessed=false; remote_contact=false.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Requester anticipated v7; current main documents operator v8 with the v2 observation tool, so v8 is consistent with the latest contract and is not CONFIG_MISMATCH. The sweep journal uses the historical package-relative default rather than an explicit operator selection, which current documentation recommends for installations; recorded as a configuration observation, not a server failure.
cases.not_verified: Journal health, execution authority, registry file identity versus an operator-approved digest.

cases.title: Design discovery
cases.observed: Two registered designs (DESIGN_A amplifier reference, DESIGN_B RC fixture), both unqualified with execution_authorized=false. DESIGN_A describe: dc/ac/tran, three variables, three measurements, five corners, protected source, owned-copy policy, bindings not_resolved, spec not_evaluated. PDK status: fixed_native_compatibility for dc/ac/tran; generic_execution_qualified=false.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Registered lookup success is kept separate from generic execution, which remains unqualified.
cases.not_verified: DESIGN_B was listed but not described.

cases.title: Catalog inspection
cases.observed: Three native analyses (fixed NN/27 C/VDD 1 V operating point, no caller parameters, cancellation unsupported). Three registered measurements with fixed units. Six analog definitions: gain and bandwidth read-eligible; phase margin, legacy analog power, offset and slew rate read_eligible=false with explicit blocking reasons. Catalog exposes one separate signed DC power reader and one targetless v2 power specification.
cases.expected_vs_actual: No invented items. Missing targets are represented as not_selected / not_evaluated.
cases.not_verified: Submit/cancel/write tools were observed as exposed names only and were never called.

cases.title: Existing native DC read
cases.observed: No admitted operation ID available: no connected read tool returns existing operation UUIDs (storage inventory job_id fields are null) and none was supplied for this run.
cases.expected_vs_actual: IDs were not generated, guessed or enumerated; no submission was made.
cases.not_verified: Remote native DC status/result through the app.

cases.title: Existing native AC / TRAN reads
cases.not_verified: Remote native AC and TRAN reads.

cases.title: Registered measurement reads
cases.observed: Definitions, units, source analysis binding, admitted-completed-only source policy and read eligibility observed.
cases.not_verified: cadence_measurement_result against an admitted operation (no operation ID).

cases.title: Analog gain / bandwidth / missing metrics
cases.observed: Gain is defined as differential gain at the first measured AC frequency (10 Hz), explicitly not DC, maximum or closed-loop gain. Bandwidth is a bracketed sampled-reference estimate without DC-plateau or interpolation-error qualification. Phase margin, offset, slew rate and legacy analog power are not read-eligible, each with a stated blocking reason.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Definitions preserve the documented scope; no metric is relabelled. No numeric target exists, so no design PASS/FAIL is produced.
cases.not_verified: cadence_analog_measurement_result values; the extra cadence_bandwidth_study_result is exposed but untested and outside the reviewed inventory.

cases.title: Dedicated power path
cases.observed: Signed DC power reader dc-supply-power-v1 (unit W, supply rails only, bias/input reported separately, preserved reference native DC only) is bound to the dc-scalars source and carries its own contract hash, distinct from the legacy analog-power v1 hash, which remains read_eligible=false. artifact_availability_assessed, extraction_authorized and execution_authorized are false. Repository source at main reads only a pinned preserved extraction and fails closed for other operations.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Separation between the new power reader and legacy analog power v1 matches the documented contract and is not a compatibility failure.
cases.not_verified: cadence_power_measurement_result against the preserved admitted DC operation (no operation ID).

cases.title: Specification
cases.observed: Legacy list returns no v1 specifications (target_status not_selected). Catalog shows one registered targetless v2 power specification. The legacy describe tool rejects that v2 ID as not registered; the v2 evaluator with its catalog contract hash returns NOT_EVALUATED / target_not_selected with no measurement read and no operation.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Consistent with the separate v8 power-specification array and v2 evaluator. Reviewers may want the legacy describe error text to point to the catalog for v2 IDs; not a failure.
cases.not_verified: Any PASS/FAIL comparison (no target is registered; none was created).

cases.title: Storage read only
cases.observed: One summary and one list page (14 artifacts, complete, no next page). All six registered groups scanned; coverage complete. Logical managed bytes about 18.0 MB versus allocated about 48.3 MB; all artifacts PROTECTED_OR_UNKNOWN (replay or evidence required); potential reclaim 0. Cumulative reservation 7,383,023,616 of 10,737,418,240 bytes; Spectre attempts 64 of 500. Filesystem free observed above the disk floor (status OK); exact value private. Totals cover registered result roots only, not whole-VM usage.
cases.expected_vs_actual: Counters are higher than the last repository-recorded 62 attempts / 7,114,588,160 bytes by 2 attempts / 268,435,456 bytes (two 128 MiB reservations). This session called no submit tool; the cause was not determined here.
cases.not_verified: Describe artifact (not needed). Cleanup plan/dry-run/execute and deletion E2E: NOT_RUN.

cases.title: Safe rejection and recovery
cases.observed: Two well-formed unregistered logical IDs: both SERVER_REJECTED with bounded invalid_input, retryable=false, no details. Subsequent runtime_info_v2 and list_designs succeeded with identical content.
cases.expected_vs_actual: This is a two-request rejection check only, not a security audit.
cases.not_verified: Malformed, oversized, traversal or write-path requests (intentionally not attempted).

cases.title: Repeated read
cases.observed: Repeated local runtime and design reads returned identical content, including semantic hash strings (direct string comparison of returned values).
cases.not_verified: Repeat of an existing remote result read (no operation ID); counter invariance across reads (storage summary taken once).

cases.title: Desktop restart and re-read
cases.observed: RESTART_NOT_VERIFIED. Awaiting a human quit and relaunch of Claude Desktop.
